title: Sola Project Observatory
northStar: Make multi-agent roadmap execution visibly inspectable live and replayable later, in a visible or headless browser, without coupling work to the browser or transferring truth, acceptance, promotion, secret custody, or Repository authority to the view.

roadmaps.title: Observatory Constitution and Truth Boundary
roadmaps.outcome: Freeze observability ownership, event vocabulary, source precedence, authority limits, and the relationship to the completed ORB campaign and drafted ORX extensions.

acceptance.mustFire: A view that grants acceptance, exposes hidden reasoning, or treats Riff as canon is refused.
acceptance.mustStaySilent: A source-linked event view reports activity without gaining product or Repository authority.
checks: Owner treaty names every authority boundary.
The completed ORB campaign remains unchanged.

phases.title: Freeze north star and operator questions
phases.mustFire: An undefined viewer or operator question refuses scope freeze.
phases.mustStaySilent: The intended watch, inspect, replay, and handoff workflows are explicit.

phases.title: Declare source precedence
phases.mustFire: A dashboard-only claim refuses truth status.
phases.mustStaySilent: Events link to durable state, Git, checks, or receipts.

phases.title: Freeze owner and authority treaty
phases.mustFire: Any observer able to self-accept or self-promote refuses.
phases.mustStaySilent: Operator, orchestrator, worker, product, Riff, and Repository roles are bounded.

phases.title: Define event vocabulary
phases.mustFire: Unknown or overloaded event kinds refuse ingestion.
phases.mustStaySilent: Lifecycle, message, tool, file, check, commit, block, and completion events are distinct.

phases.title: Separate transcript from hidden reasoning
phases.mustFire: A request to capture private chain-of-thought refuses.
phases.mustStaySilent: Only emitted messages, tool metadata, and durable artifacts are represented.

phases.title: Freeze campaign provenance
phases.mustFire: Missing source revision or gate catalog refuses dispatch.
phases.mustStaySilent: Twelve roadmaps and seventy-two two-sided phase gates are hashed and readable.

acceptance.mustFire: Tamper, torn writes, duplicate sequence, or invalid snapshot lineage refuses recovery.
acceptance.mustStaySilent: A killed collector restarts and reconstructs identical visible state from journal plus snapshot.
checks: Journal is append-only and content-addressed.
Compaction never deletes authoritative receipts.

phases.title: Prove deterministic replay
